inicio.titulo: ObraFácil: construction management app and site diary
inicio.descricao: Construction management app for mobile and computer: project schedule, site diary with photos, project finances, team and a client portal. Start free.

ajuda.descricao: Step-by-step guides for the ObraFácil construction management app: site diary, schedule, project finances, team and client portal, with real app screens.

app.descricao: Construction management app for builders, contractors, civil engineers and architects: stage-by-stage project schedule, site diary (daily reports) with photos and PDF, quality inspection checklists with sign-off, project finances, team and payroll, purchases and stock, and a portal where the client follows the project. Works on Android, iPhone, Windows and the web, even offline on site.

footer.ctaTitle: Ready to organise your next project?

faq.a11: Yes. With Quality checklists you inspect each piece of work item by item, with photos, record any non-conformance with a corrective action and re-inspection, and sign off the work. On your phone it works even with no signal: what you record syncs when you're back online. On the free plan, you can start 3 checklists in total with the 27 ready-made templates, so you can try it out; on PRO, checklists are unlimited and you can create your company's own templates. The ready-made templates are examples to review and adapt: they don't replace the qualified professional responsible for the works, and they don't certify compliance with any standard or quality program.
